title: Augustin Bell

lines.speaker: bell
lines.text: You came on time, Elias. You always did.

lines.speaker: bell
lines.text: The Board wanted me dead. They took your dog to make you do it. I gave you a better song.

lines.speaker: bell
lines.text: I conducted you. Now the last movement. Keep your left guard up.
